title_sq: Tek OxA Residence, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!!
description_sq: Tek OxA Residence shitet super apartament 1+1 me planimetri te rregullt. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 1 te nje godine 3-kateshe, si dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto prej 60.6 m2 nga ku siperfaqja neto eshte 53.2 m2. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, dhoma e gjumit, tualeti dhe ballkoni. Rezidenca OxA, ndertimi me i ri i Kontakt shume prane Dajtit ofron mundesi ideale banimi me nje pamje fantastike.
title_en: At OxA Residence, 1+1 apartment for sale, with a regular floor plan!!!
description_en: At OxA Residence, a super apartment 1+1 with regular floor plan is for sale. The apartment is located on the 1st floor of a 3-story building, and has a gross area of ​​60.6 m2, of which the net area is 53.2 m2. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the living room together with the kitchen corner, the bedroom, the toilet and the balcony. The OxA residence, the newest Kontakt building very close to Dajti, offers ideal housing opportunities with a fantastic view.
